title: Enforce shared 100,000 requests/month allowance across free account projects

endpoints.before: Free projects were governed only by the 120 requests/minute per-project quota and expensive v1 per-operation limits without a monthly account cap, and RateLimit-Policy headers assumed 60-second windows.
endpoints.after: Free accounts share an authoritative 100,000 requests/month allowance across all free projects, API keys, and console sessions across legacy and v1 gateways, resetting on the 1st of each calendar month at 00:00 UTC alongside existing per-project minute and expensive-operation limits. Paid projects (pro, enterprise) are exempt, while custom RPM overrides on free projects retain the monthly cap. Key rotation/deletion and project recreation never reset account usage. Monthly exhaustion returns 429 MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED with Retry-After until reset and calendar-aware RateLimit headers; unavailable accounting returns 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE.
endpoints.clientAction: Track free-account monthly usage in the developer portal or via RateLimit headers, respect Retry-After until 00:00 UTC on the 1st of next month on 429 MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, or request a Pro/Enterprise tier upgrade in Rate Limits.
